definition: means the process of intimating a claim to the insurer or TPA through any of the recognized modes of communication.
plain: Telling the insurer or their TPA that a claim is coming, through any of the channels the policy recognises.
whyItMatters: There are deadlines — commonly 24 hours for an emergency admission and 48 to 72 hours before a planned one — and missing them gives the insurer grounds to question the claim even when the treatment was entirely covered. Intimate first, sort out the paperwork afterwards.
